svg.title: Compare answers to a mail delivery case
svg.desc: Four helpers get the same mail records. A useful answer separates evidence from a guess. Ask. Give each available helper the same starting facts. Keep the first reply. Record its claim and its evidence. Compare. Check the proposed cause against the records and the later retest.
